notes.title: Tank Assault X on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

We are happy to announce our new game on Steam! Fight for humanity against alien invaders on six different planets. Protect our homeworld and strike back to Krisan!

Please join our community, your feedback is really important to improve the game. Thank you!

Starwind Games Team
